title.en: Tale 18 — The Crow Among the Owls

sentences.en: The owls found him thrown out and wounded.

sentences.ar: قال: الغربان عملوا فيّ هيك لأني حكيت عنكم منيح.
sentences.en: He said: the crows did this to me because I spoke well of you.
They believed him and took him to their cave.

sentences.ar: ضل عندهم شهور وهو بيتفرج وبيعد.
sentences.en: He stayed with them for months, watching and counting.

sentences.ar: بيوم، جاب حطب ورماه عند باب المغارة.
sentences.en: One day, he brought firewood and threw it at the cave door.
And he brought the crows and they lit the fire.

sentences.ar: العدو اللي بتاخده لبيتك أخطر من اللي برا.
sentences.en: The enemy you take into your house is more dangerous than the one outside.
